# @rnw-community/fast-style

> Pre-computed lookup constants for rapid React Native flexbox and font styling with IDE autocomplete, built on
> `@rnw-community/object-field-tree`. Peers: `react` (>=18) and `react-native` (>=0.72).

Index into property chains like `Flex.row.flexEnd.stretch` or `Font.ptSansBold.xs.blue` and spread the result into a
style object or pass it inline. `getFont` requires string values in the font-size enum and throws otherwise.

## API reference

- [`Flex`](readme.md#flex): Constant tree keyed direction -> justifyContent -> alignItems whose leaves are flexbox style objects.
- [`FlexDirectionEnum`, `FlexJustifyContentEnum`, `FlexAlignItemsEnum`](readme.md#enums-backing-flexs-keys): Enums whose member names form the `Flex` property chain.
- [`getFont`](readme.md#font): Builds a project-specific `Font` tree keyed family -> size -> color from caller enums, with optional additional `TextStyle`.

## Architecture & conventions

- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/rnw-community/rnw-community/blob/master/packages/fast-style/AGENTS.md): Source layout, `combine()`-based construction, dependencies, and coverage.
